Project API Reference

Flask Backend (app.py)

Flask Backend for the ctrlX Dashboard App.

This single backend supports two run modes based on the APP_ENVIRONMENT environment variable:

  • ‘production’: (Default) Runs inside the ctrlX CORE snap. Serves the compiled Angular frontend and communicates with the local Data Layer.

  • ‘development’: Runs on a local PC. Provides a CORS-enabled API for an external Angular development server (ng serve) and connects to a remote ctrlX CORE over the network.

Now powered by WebSockets (Flask-SocketIO) for real-time metric pushes and encrypted HTTPS / WSS communication.

app.authenticate_to_core() → bool[source]

Authenticate against the Identity Manager of the ctrlX CORE.

The authentication method depends on the current environment: - Production: Authentication is handled by the system context (assumes token is local). - Development: Performs a remote HTTPS login using configured credentials.

Returns:

True if authentication succeeded, False otherwise.

Return type:

bool

app.fetch_metrics_from_core() → dict[source]

Query all configured system metrics from the ctrlX CORE Data Layer.

Reads values such as scheduler state, CPU utilization, RAM usage, and disk storage. Re-authenticates automatically if a 401 Unauthorized status is returned.

Returns:

A dictionary containing the retrieved metrics.

Return type:

dict

app.handle_connect() → None

Handle incoming WebSocket client connections.

Triggers an immediate metrics push upon connection and starts the background polling task thread if it is not already running.

app.handle_disconnect() → None

Handle WebSocket client disconnections.

app.metrics_polling_task() → None[source]

Cyclic background task to poll metrics from the ctrlX CORE.

Executes infinitely, fetching metrics every 2 seconds and pushing them to all connected WebSocket clients via the ‘metrics_update’ event.

app.set_scheduler_state() → tuple

Change the controller’s scheduler state (OPERATING, SETUP, SERVICE).

Expects a JSON body containing the target state. Sends a PUT request to the ctrlX CORE scheduler node. Pushes updated metrics immediately to all clients.

Returns:

A tuple containing a JSON response and the HTTP status code.

Return type:

tuple

Deployment Automation (install_snap.py)

Python script to install a Snap App on a Bosch Rexroth ctrlX CORE via REST API.

This script runs fully interactively. It prompts the user for connection details, automatically applying defaults upon pressing Enter, while requiring a valid path to a local .snap package.

Optimizations: 1. Pre-flight check: Verifies if the App is already installed (avoids Bad Requests). 2. Safety check: Verifies if other service tasks are active. 3. Universal API Support: Auto-detects the Scheduler API payload format of ctrlX OS. 4. State Caching: Remembers the working API format to avoid unnecessary requests. 5. Smart Polling: Resolves terminal 100% hung states and auto-cleanup tasks. 6. Retry State Restoring: Tries up to 6 times to switch back to OPERATING, giving the

Package Manager time to finish registering the Snap in the background.

install_snap.change_scheduler_state(target_state: str) → bool[source]

Change the scheduler operating state (OPERATING, SETUP, SERVICE). Tries multiple payload formats to ensure compatibility with all ctrlX OS versions.

install_snap.check_active_tasks() → bool[source]

Queries the active package manager tasks. Returns True if an active/running task is found, False otherwise.

install_snap.check_architecture_compatibility(snap_path, expected_arch) → bool[source]

Check if the Snap filename is compatible with the controller’s architecture.

install_snap.configure_connection() → None[source]

Prompt the user for ctrlX CORE connection details.

install_snap.fetch_bearer_token() → bool[source]

Authenticate against the Identity Manager of the ctrlX CORE. :return: True if authentication succeeded, False otherwise. :rtype: bool

install_snap.get_controller_info() → tuple[str, str][source]

Read the electronic typeplate to determine the hardware model and architecture. :return: A tuple containing the model name and the expected architecture. :rtype: tuple[str, str]

install_snap.get_installed_app_info(app_name: str) → dict | None[source]

Checks if the app is already installed on the ctrlX CORE. Returns the package info dict if installed, None otherwise.

Retrieve the current Scheduler state from the Data Layer.

Retrieves the status of a specific background task from the Package Manager API.

install_snap.install_snap(snap_path) → bool[source]

install_snap.main() → None[source]

Main entry point for the script.

install_snap.wait_for_scheduler_state(target_state, timeout_seconds=60) → bool[source]

Poll the Scheduler state until it reaches the target state or times out.

install_snap.wait_for_task_completion(task_id: str, timeout_seconds: int = 300) → bool[source]

Polls the task endpoint until the installation task is complete. Handles auto-cleanup/disappearance of completed tasks in ctrlX OS.
